```{r MDS-UPDRS load}
MDS_data <- read.csv("C:/Users/teger/Downloads/Parkinson's Data/MDS-UPDRS Data.csv")

colnames(MDS_data)

```
```{r MDS-UPRS setup}


part_one <- MDS_data %>%
  select(healthCode, MDS.UPDRS1.1, MDS.UPDRS1.3, MDS.UPDRS1.4,
         MDS.UPDRS1.5, MDS.UPDRS1.7, MDS.UPDRS1.8) %>%
  mutate(sum1 = rowSums(across(starts_with("MDS.UPDRS1"))))



part_two <- MDS_data %>%
  select(healthCode, MDS.UPDRS2.1, MDS.UPDRS2.4, MDS.UPDRS2.5, MDS.UPDRS2.6, 
         MDS.UPDRS2.7, MDS.UPDRS2.8, MDS.UPDRS2.9, MDS.UPDRS2.10, 
         MDS.UPDRS2.12, MDS.UPDRS2.13) %>%
  mutate(sum2 = rowSums(across(starts_with("MDS.UPDRS2"))))

MD_merged_parts <- left_join(part_one %>% select(healthCode, sum1),
                          part_two %>% select(healthCode, sum2),
                          by = "healthCode")
head(MD_merged_parts)

```

```{r Demographic load}
demo_data <- read.csv("C:/Users/teger/Downloads/Parkinson's Data/MDS-UPDRS Data.csv")

```
```{r PDQ8 Data Load}
PD_data <- read.csv("C:/Users/teger/Downloads/Parkinson's Data/PDQ8 Survey.csv")

colnames(PD_data)

```
```{r PDQ8 Score Conversion}

word_map <- c(Never = 0, Occasionally = 1, Sometimes = 2, Often = 3, Always = 4)

library(dplyr)

PD_data <- PD_data %>%
  mutate(across(PDQ8.1:PDQ8.8, ~ word_map[.x]))


colnames(PD_data)
```
to maintain original word answers, use this instead:

PD_data <- PD_data %>%
  mutate(across(PDQ8.1:PDQ8.8, ~ word_map[.x], .names = "{.col}_num"))
  
  
```{r PDQ8 score calculation}


PD_data <- PD_data %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(total_score = sum(c_across(PDQ8.1:PDQ8.8), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()



colnames(PD_data)

```

```{r Merging of Data Frames}

final <- left_join(PD_data, demo_data, by = "healthCode", relationship = "many-to-many")

final <- final%>%
  left_join(pos, by = "healthCode", relationship = "many-to-many")

final <- final%>%
  left_join(neg, by = "healthCode", relationship = "many-to-many")

final <- final%>%
  left_join(MD_merged_parts, by = "healthCode", relationship = "many-to-many")


  
colnames(final)

```
